sec: RPRF, vascular causes & RAS introduction · p749

items.q: In the days-to-weeks branch, the bracket 'Rare cause' is drawn against which two entries?
items.exp: Under rapidly progressive renal failure the list is RPGN (m/c, diagnosed with biopsy), then severe ATN and TMA grouped by a bracket labelled 'Rare cause'. (Book p749)

items.q: A 32-year-old has creatinine rising from 1.2 to 5.0 mg/dL in ten days with an active sediment and 2+ proteinuria. Following the non-CKD flowchart, the picture is:
opts: Days to weeks tempo — rapidly progressive renal failure, with RPGN the m/c cause and biopsy the confirmation
Hours to days tempo — pre-renal AKI with normal urine analysis
Normal RFT with renal disease — asymptomatic urine abnormality
Hypertensive crisis — vascular cause, so screen for renal artery stenosis
items.exp: The 'Days to weeks' arm carries rapidly progressive renal failure whose m/c cause is RPGN, diagnosed with biopsy; the tempo and the active sediment exclude the pre-renal and vascular arms. (Book p749)
